# Vendored files (used only by the CrazyGames build)

- `three/`: Three.js r160 (`build/three.module.min.js` plus the post-processing add-ons the game imports), copied unchanged from the npm package `three@0.160.0`. MIT license, see `three/LICENSE`.
- `fonts/`: Fredoka and Lilita One, latin and latin-ext subsets, from Google Fonts. Both are under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 (https://openfontlicense.org).
